entries.text: A new species, the Lamemi, branched off the Lameza.
Among the Lamere, a group grew apart: the Lamera.
The Nemafa are thriving: from 23 to 47 in 30 days.
The earth shook and the land shifted.
Hard times for the Lamege: only 9 are left of 24.
